items.name: Cottbus Cubing 2025
items.information:
### Deutsch

Herzlich willkommen zur Cottbuser Cubing Competition!

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur ersten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Vom 15. bis 16. November 2025 dreht sich in Cottbus alles um Würfel, Zeiten und jede Menge Spaß. Diese Premiere ist nicht nur ein sportliches Event, sondern auch ein Schritt, die Cubing-Community in Brandenburg weiter wachsen zu lassen. Wir sind stolz, mit euch gemeinsam Cubing-Geschichte in der Lausitz zu schreiben.

Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln!

[Event-Trailer](https://youtube.com/shorts/Va4iRMysVpQ?si=ID4au8HW_QbFkCFX)

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**

### English

Welcome to the Cottbuser Cubing Competition!

We’re very excited to welcome you all to the first official speedcubing competition in the Lausitz region! From November 15 to 16, 2025, everything in Cottbus will revolve around cubes, times, and a whole lot of fun.This premiere is not just a sporting event, but also a milestone in helping the cubing community grow here in Brandenburg. We’re proud to be making cubing history in the Lausitz together with you.

We wish all participants exciting solves, fair competition, and – above all – lots of fun with the cubes!

[Event-Trailer](https://youtube.com/shorts/Va4iRMysVpQ?si=ID4au8HW_QbFkCFX)

**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEzOTkxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--afaa0c7e07a9256263f11b2588651c4929c99f85/Logo_Web.png)

所有項目的決賽將會預留最多8個名額或50%的名額(以較少者為準)給代表香港的參賽者。

而相關有預留名額的輪次，預留名額將優先按上一輪次代表香港的參賽者的成績排名安排晉級，之後再按上一輪次所有參賽者的成績排名安排晉級餘下的名額。

The main competition day will take place on Saturday, November 15th, in the Galaxy Rooms of the UTD Student Union. Sunday afternoon will feature blindfolded events and will take place in the Sciences Building (SCI Room 2.210). 

On Sunday Morning, we will have a separate Fewest Moves competition, [Texas FMC Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasFMCChampionship2025). You can find more information on the [Texas FMC Championship 2025 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeOninRichardson2025#64575-texas-fmc-championship-2025).

The University of Texas at Dallas and the Comet Cubing Club will not take custodial responsibility of minors while participating in Cube On in Richardson 2025. Custodial responsibility will remain with teachers K-12, parents, legal guardians, and chaperones.

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
